prompt: One day of a trip as a timeline, with adding and removing plans.
shortDesc: One trip day as a timeline (from GetTripOverview days[]): date header with weather and holiday chips, then each plan with time, title, location and cost. Signed-in users can add a plan or remove one; the page reloads after a change.

props.name: day
props.description: One entry of GetTripOverview days: { date, weather: { summary, tempMaxC, tempMinC } | null, holidays: string[], items: [{ id, time?, title, kind, location?, cost?, currency? }] }.

props.name: currency
props.description: Currency for costs without their own. Default EUR.

styling.notes: Timeline rail with coloured dots per kind (food coral, transport harbour, others sea); mono times and costs; holiday chip in pale coral.

interactions.bodyShape: { intent: 'add an itinerary item', tripId, date, title, kind, time?, location?, cost?, currency?, outputFormat: { ok: 'boolean', id: 'string' } }
{ intent: 'remove an itinerary item', tripId, itemId, outputFormat: { ok: 'boolean' } }
